headline.purpose: Workspace section headers (Draft board, Weekly decisions, Model room) (h2).

body.purpose: Paragraphs, form labels, buttons, inputs, telemetry values, and dataframe cells.

label.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked structural labels: telemetry-rail captions and the forecast-state caption. Same body face, not a separate one.

shadows.name: ranking-sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Every st.dataframe ranking table; paired with a 1px solid Grid Line border and 8px radius.

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Resting state for primary and download buttons.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Button hover state, paired with transform: translateY(-1px) — the button lifts rather than presses.

motion.name: field-lock
motion.value: width 4% -> 18%, filter brightness(.7) -> brightness(1), 700ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1), both
motion.purpose: The command header's bottom-edge Field Green underline animates in on load, standing in for the system's one moment of motion. Disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Buttons translateY(-1px) into the deeper Button Hover shadow on hover/focus.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width: container padding tightens to 3.35rem .8rem 3rem, the command header collapses to one column (badge drops below title/description), the telemetry rail reflows to a 2-column grid with alternating border removal, and workspace-pill labels shrink to .74rem. The three-cell workspace grid and the QB-only expander are unchanged at this breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Green-deep, small-radius call-to-action that lifts into a deeper soft shadow on hover, with a distinct cyan focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #214c34; color: #e5f3e7; border: 1px solid rgba(119, 213, 132, .48); border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16); font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a6140; border-color: #77d584; color: #eef8ef; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #62b9c8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: File Uploader Button
components.description: Quieter surface-high button used for the sidebar's model-sheet uploader; same small radius, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-upload { background: #1b2b2f; color: #dce8e4; border: 1px solid #3c5b60; border-radius: 7px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; }

components.name: Workspace Selector
components.description: Three equal pills on a panel-deep tray selecting Draft Board / Weekly Decisions / Model Room; a real CSS grid that never stacks, even on mobile.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .35rem; max-width: 36rem; padding: .3rem; background: #121e21; border: 1px solid #294044; border-radius: 9px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: .58rem 1rem; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; color: #dce8e4; } .ds-tab-active { background: #214c34; border-color: rgba(119, 213, 132, .28); color: #e5f3e7; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-tab { font-size: .74rem; padding: .55rem .2rem; } }

components.name: Command Header + Forecast State
components.description: Gradient masthead panel with the display title and description beside a bordered forecast-state badge; an animated field-green underline runs along its bottom edge.
components.html:
Fantasy Forecast Center

Season-long draft value and weekly matchup signals, kept in separate decision lanes and tied to the same model evidence.

Forecast stateUpcoming forecast
components.css: .ds-header { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 2rem; background: linear-gradient(112deg, #1b2b2f, #121e21); border: 1px solid #294044; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; padding: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); overflow: hidden; } .ds-header::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; width: 18%; background: #77d584; animation: field-lock 700ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) both; } @keyframes field-lock { from { width: 4%; filter: brightness(.7); } to { width: 18%; filter: brightness(1); } } .ds-header h1 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bahnschrift', 'Arial Narrow', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 4.1rem); line-height: .94; letter-spacing: -.035em; color: #dce8e4; } .ds-header p { color: #94aaa5; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; margin: .7rem 0 0; max-width: 66ch; } .ds-forecast-state { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-self: center; background: rgba(119, 213, 132, .075); border: 1px solid rgba(119, 213, 132, .38); border-radius: 8px; padding: .75rem .9rem; min-width: 12.5rem; } .ds-status-dot { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: .55rem; height: .55rem; margin: .45rem .7rem 0 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #77d584; } .ds-forecast-state span { color: #94aaa5; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-forecast-state strong { color: #77d584; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .93rem; font-weight: 650; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 1.2rem; padding: 1.35rem; } }

components.name: Telemetry Rail
components.description: Dense horizontal strip of provenance stat cells directly beneath the command header.
components.css: .ds-telemetry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(125px, 1fr)); background: #162326; border: 1px solid #294044; border-top: 0; margin-bottom: 1.35rem; } .ds-telemetry-item { border-right: 1px solid #294044; padding: .8rem 1rem .9rem; } .ds-telemetry-item:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-telemetry-item span { display: block; color: #94aaa5; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .65rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .095em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: .28rem; } .ds-telemetry-item strong { display: block; color: #dce8e4; font-family: 'Bahnschrift', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .93rem; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-telemetry { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-telemetry-item { border-bottom: 1px solid #294044; padding: .72rem .8rem; } }

components.name: Ranking Sheet Table
components.description: The draft-board / weekly-board data table, lifted off the charcoal canvas with a soft black shadow.
components.css: .ds-sheet { border: 1px solid #294044; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18); overflow: hidden; background: #162326; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; color: #dce8e4; } .ds-sheet table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-sheet th { text-align: left; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; font-size: .75rem; color: #94aaa5; border-bottom: 1px solid #294044; padding: .5rem .75rem; } .ds-sheet td { padding: .5rem .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #294044; }

components.name: Sidebar Filing Panel
components.description: Permanent panel-deep control desk holding the model-sheet loader and mission-control filters.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #121e21; border-right: 1px solid #294044; padding: 1rem; color: #dce8e4; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar h2 { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #294044; padding-bottom: .65rem; margin: 1.45rem 0 .85rem; color: #dce8e4; } .ds-sidebar select { background: #1b2b2f; border: 1px solid #3c5b60; border-radius: 7px; color: #dce8e4; padding: .4rem .6rem; width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
This is a stadium operations display for player evidence, not a generic analytics dashboard: a charcoal field, gridded like turf under stadium lights, carries a single restrained accent strategy so model provenance never gets lost behind ranking noise. Field Green is the only signal for state and action; Comparison Cyan and Actual Amber carry the two evidence roles a forecast needs — what the models project against each other, and what already happened. There is no paper, no ink stamp, no cursive handwriting anywhere in this system; every trace of the prior ledger metaphor has been retired.

The build stays disciplined about role separation: green signals state and action, cyan compares model output, amber marks confirmed fact, and a small five-color evidence palette (green, cyan, amber, coral, violet) extends only as far as the weekly trend chart needs it. A compact command header and a live telemetry rail lead directly into three persistent workspaces (Draft Board, Weekly Decisions, Model Room), rendered as one equal-width row at every viewport, because moving between season-long and single-week decisions without losing model context is the product's central promise.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal-field canvas with a faint green-tinted 40px grid, read as a night-lit stadium turf
Small radii everywhere (6–10px) plus one fully circular status dot; no clip-path notches, no square corners
Soft, blurred, black-based drop shadows for elevation — never a hard flat offset
A compact command header with an animated field-lock underline and a live telemetry rail as the signature devices
Three equal, never-stacking workspace tabs above the active ranking surface

rules.name: The Field Signal Rule
rules.body: Field Green (and its Green Deep variant) is reserved for state and action chrome — the status dot, the forecast-state badge, the active workspace pill, buttons, the slider thumb, and the active toggle. It never appears as a comparison or actual-value color inside a chart.

rules.name: The Confirmed-Fact Amber Rule
rules.body: Actual Amber marks only confirmed, already-happened values — the draft-board's actual-points tick and the trend chart's actual line. A projection is never drawn in amber.

rules.name: The Evidence Palette Order Rule
rules.body: When the weekly trend chart compares more than one player, added lines take colors from a fixed five-step sequence — Field Green, Comparison Cyan, Actual Amber, Evidence Coral, Evidence Violet — always in that order, never reshuffled or reassigned per player.

rules.name: The One Display Face Rule
rules.body: Bahnschrift is the only face used for h1–h3. Every other role — including uppercase labels — stays on the Segoe UI body stack, distinguished by weight and tracking, never by swapping fonts.

rules.name: The Equal Three Rule
rules.body: The workspace selector is a real CSS grid of repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) — Draft Board, Weekly Decisions, Model Room always render as one equal-width row, at every viewport width, with only label size and padding shrinking below 760px.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in this system is a soft, blurred, black-based drop shadow (0 Npx Npx rgba(0,0,0,.16–.22)). A hard, non-blurred, colored offset shadow never appears here.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: Corner treatment is a small radius (6–10px) scaled to the surface's size, never zero and never a clip-path notch. The single exception is the fully circular (50%) status dot.

dos: Do reserve Field Green (and Green Deep) for state and action chrome only — the status dot, forecast-state badge, active workspace pill, buttons, slider thumb, and toggle.
Do keep the workspace selector a true repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) grid at every viewport; shrink only label size and padding below 760px.
Do use soft, blurred, black-based shadows (0 Npx Npx rgba(0,0,0,.16-.22)) for elevation; never a hard offset.
Do follow the fixed five-color evidence-palette order (green, cyan, amber, coral, violet) when the trend chart adds compared players.
Do keep Bahnschrift exclusive to h1–h3; everything else, including uppercase labels, stays on Segoe UI.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the command header's field-lock animation.
donts: Don't use Actual Amber for a projected or comparison value — it marks confirmed actuals only.
Don't add a clip-path notch or a square corner anywhere; every surface carries a small radius (6–10px) except the fully circular status dot.
Don't stack, wrap, or collapse the workspace selector into a dropdown on narrow viewports.
Don't substitute the Comparison Cyan focus-visible outline with the Field Green hover treatment; the two must stay visually distinct.
